subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): classify model calls as client spans

question: Should legacy-named model-call spans change from implicit `INTERNAL` to standards-aligned `CLIENT` for every OpenTelemetry exporter user, despite requiring some existing dashboards to update their kind filters?
rationale: The code and OpenTelemetry contract support the change, but choosing to alter an already-exported classification value is a compatibility decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Standards-Aligned Classification
options.body: Land the patch and document that existing model-span queries filtering on `INTERNAL` must include `CLIENT` after upgrade.

options.title: Defer The Classification Change
options.body: Keep the current exported value until maintainers choose a broader telemetry compatibility or release-transition policy.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Through An Opt-In
options.body: Add an explicit transition mechanism, accepting extra configuration and long-term dual-behavior complexity to avoid changing existing consumers by default.

recommendation.title: Accept Standards-Aligned Classification
recommendation.body: Land the patch and document that existing model-span queries filtering on `INTERNAL` must include `CLIENT` after upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the originating GenAI diagnostics behavior and have recent history on the affected exporter surface.
